question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query: SELECT CASE WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0 THEN 'no_item_line' WHEN ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'one_line' ELSE 'multi_line' END AS ORDER_GROUP, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT, AVG(ITEM_QUANTITY) AS AVG_ORDERED_UNITS_PER_ORDER, COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::FLOAT AS SHARE_OF_ALL_ORDERS_WITH_MULTI_LINES FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ORDERS, COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1) AS MULTI_LINE_ORDERS, COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::FLOAT AS MULTI_LINE_SHARE_OF_ALL_ORDERS, COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0) AS NO_ITEM_LINE_ORDERS, AVG(IFF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1, ITEM_QUANTITY, NULL)) AS AVG_UNITS_ONE_LINE_ORDERS, AVG(IFF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1, ITEM_QUANTITY, NULL)) AS AVG_UNITS_MULTI_LINE_ORDERS FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'

action.answer: For 2025 recorded orders (ORDER_DATE from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31), 3,052,089 of 4,359,773 orders had more than one item line: 70.005686% of all orders. Average ordered units per order were 1.219753 for the 1,307,684 one-line orders and 3.484769 for the 3,052,089 multi-line orders. Orders with no item line: 0. These unit averages use order-level ordered quantity, not item-line count.
